stories.title: Tailscale Rushes Patches After Uncoordinated Disclosure of ‘Tailworm’ Flaws
stories.description: Tailscale is preparing a patch for Tailscale SSH flaws whose details went public over the weekend, before any fixes had been released.

stories.title: Microsoft Authenticator Flaw Let Permissionless Android Apps Steal Work Account Tokens
stories.description: Microsoft fixed an Android Authenticator flaw that lets malicious apps impersonate Teams and obtain work account tokens under certain conditions.

stories.title: Unexplained DreamHost Incident Prompts Email, FTP Password Resets

stories.title: Keystone to Destroy 18,835 Hardware Wallets After Hackers Steal Device Verification Key
